one_line_description: Customer support software with ticketing, live chat, and knowledge base features
auth_methods_evidence: The Composio registry lists OAuth2 as an authentication scheme for Zendesk.
self_serve_evidence: The Zendesk website (https://www.zendesk.com/) offers free trials and self-service sign-up options for developers to access the API.
buildability_rationale: Zendesk offers OAuth2 authentication, comprehensive API documentation, a broad API surface with multiple endpoints, and is Composio-supported with 452 tools.
agent_notes: Zendesk provides extensive API documentation covering multiple capabilities including ticketing, help center, live chat, voice, and more. The Composio registry confirms OAuth2 authentication and a large number of available tools.
